item.title: General: JEE: Included in AGRIS
item.description: Journal of Extension Education (JEE) has been included in International System for Agricultural Science and Technology (AGRIS) of FAO,, which is a multilingual bibliographic database that connects users directly to a rich collection of research and worldwide technical information on food and agriculture.

item.title: General: Professor J Oliver passes away
item.description: We regret to inform you of the sad demise of Prof. Dr. J. Oliver, Former Chief Editor of Journal of Extension Education, Councilor of Extension Education Society, and Former Director of Extension Education, Tamil Nadu Agricultural University, Coimbatore on 12.4.2023. Specialized in Farm Journalism, Dr Oliver, as a pioneering initiative, had developed a readability measure for assessing Tamil Publications. Our thoughts go out to his family and friends.

item.title: Special Issue of JEE: JEE Special Issue on “Social Media and Agricultural Extension” - Call for Papers
item.description: Call for Papers: Journal of Extension Education: Special Issue on “Social Media and Agricultural Extension” Submission deadline: May 31, 2023 JEE is soliciting manuscripts for its forthcoming Special Issue on “Social Media and Agricultural Extension”. The objective is to publish quality research papers on both positive and negative aspects of using Social media in Agricultural Extension. Only original scientific research articles with relevance to extension education will be accepted. Manuscript

item.title: General: Journal of Extension Education - Now Indexed in EBSCO !
item.description: Dear JEE readers, We are happy to announce that JEE (Journal of Extension Education) has now been indexed in EBSCO . EBSCO is a leading provider of research databases, e-journals, e-books, and other valuable resources for academic libraries, corporations, and other institutions. This inclusion would expand the visibility of JEE by providing wider access to readers across the world.
